title: DNA Extraction Protocol Using Modified BOMB Method
author: Guan Jie Phang

steps.title: Add 0.5 mm beads
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 0.5 mm glass beads to a 2 mL screw‑cap tube.

steps.title: Add 1 mm beads
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 1 mm glass beads to the same 2 mL screw‑cap tube.

steps.title: Prepare and add lysis mix
steps.instruction: Prepare Lysis master mix by mixing 225 µL TE buffer, 375 µL lysis buffer and 270 µL of 10 M ammonium acetate (keep on ice at 4 °C); then add 870 µL of this master mix to the tube.

steps.title: Add sample tissue
steps.instruction: Add 20–50 mg of sample (up to 100 mg if acceptable) to the tube.

steps.title: Vortex for lysis
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a vortex mixer, balance tubes, and vortex at 3200 rpm for 4 min (00:04:00).

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 10 × g, 25 °C for 3 min.

steps.title: Add isopropanol to well 1
steps.instruction: Dispense 350 µL of isopropanol into well 1 of a 96‑deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads to well 1
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of magnetic beads (10 mg/mL) to well 1; vortex the bead suspension bottle before use and after adding to every three samples to keep beads in suspension.

steps.title: Add lysate to well 1
steps.instruction: Transfer 300–500 µL of cleared lysate (free of cell debris) from the centrifuged tube to well 1.

steps.title: Add isopropanol to well 2
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL of isopropanol to well 2.

steps.title: Add 80 % ethanol to well 3
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of 80 % ethanol to well 3.

steps.title: Add 95 % ethanol to well 4
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of 95 % ethanol to well 4.

steps.title: Add DEPC‑treated water to well 6
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of DEPC‑treated water to well 6.

steps.title: Load plate into ZiXpress 32
steps.instruction: Place the prepared 96‑deep‑well plate into the ZiXpress 32 automated DNA extraction system and program the following steps:

substeps.instruction: Well 1: Standby 1 min, Mix 0 min, Volume 10 µL, Mix speed 1000, Magnet 3 s, Temp 120 °C
Well 2: Standby 2 min, Mix 0 min, Volume 2 µL, Mix speed 400, Magnet 3 s, Temp 60 °C
Well 3: Standby 3 min, Mix 0 min, Volume 2 µL, Mix speed 300, Magnet 3 s, Temp 60 °C
Well 4: Standby 4 min, Mix 15 min, Volume 0 µL, Mix speed 0, Magnet 0 s, Temp 0 °C
Well 5: Standby 4 min, Mix 0 min, Volume 2 µL, Mix speed 300, Magnet 3 s, Temp 60 °C
Well 6: Standby 5 min, Mix 0 min, Volume 1 µL, Mix speed 300, Magnet 3 s, Temp 0 °C
Well 7: Standby 6 min, Mix 0 min, Volume 5 µL, Mix speed 100, Magnet 3 s, Temp 120 °C, Additional parameter 55 (as listed)

steps.title: Magnetically pellet beads
steps.instruction: After the automated run finishes, place the plate on a 96‑well magnetic plate to collect magnetic bead residues.

steps.title: Add DDW to well 5
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of double‑distilled water (DDW) to well 5.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of the eluate from well 5, avoiding magnetic beads, for downstream applications.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads for cleanup
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of magnetic beads (10 mg/mL) to well 1 of the 96‑deep‑well plate (optional post‑extraction cleanup).
